name: splicewire/laravel-beam-mcp
description: The MCP arm of the schemastud beam family: any beam-tier package exposes an MCP tool by annotating the tool class #[McpTool('group')] — no Tower-side edit required. Ships the attribute-scan McpToolManifest registry (grouped tool-class discovery, self-described into beam-core's ManifestIndex) that a host MCP server (e.g. Splicewire\Tower\Mcp\Servers\SplicewireServer) composes at boot, replacing a hand-maintained tool-class list.

package-topology.because: beam-mcp is the MCP arm of the beam family — it owns the attribute-scan tool-group registry (#[McpTool] → McpToolManifest) that lets any beam-tier package expose an MCP tool without a Tower-side edit. As a particle-adjacent CONSUMER it depends DOWN on base beam for the ManifestIndex self-description seam, and on laravel/mcp + rushing/laravel-mcp-registry for the ToolGroup/Tool vocabulary it composes into — a plain in-estate require, mustRequire. beam-mcp must NEVER reach UP into the tower / satellite tiers that consume it: the registry is POPULATED by beam-tier producers and READ by tower's SplicewireServer, never the reverse (no beam-mcp → tower edge).

noRequire.because: beam-mcp is reusable by any beam site; it is consumed DOWN by the tower host (SplicewireServer reads McpToolManifest) — beam-mcp never requires tower (no reverse/upward edge)
the foundation never reaches up into the consumer-app tier
